profile_text.body:
Beautiful.ai is a presentation software company founded in 2016 that describes itself as an AI presentation platform built for enterprise teams. The product is designed to help teams across functions such as sales and strategy create on-brand slide decks more quickly, using a library of over 300 auto-aligning Smart Slide layouts, shared brand themes, and data visualization options including charts, graphs, timelines, and diagrams. The company positions its tool as producing work-ready decks rather than rough drafts, and offers a 14-day free trial along with plans for individuals, small teams, startups, enterprise deployments, and one-time use.

The platform's primary AI feature is called Create with AI, described as a context-aware workflow that guides users from an initial prompt or document through a low-fidelity outline stage before generating polished slides, allowing iterative edits at the individual slide level without discarding the full deck. The company claims clients including Paciolan and Cvent each cut presentation design time by 75% after adopting the product, and says IDC analysts used it to reduce production time and surface new data insights.

The site's held facts confirm Beautiful.ai is tracked under the Slides and Presentations category for AI-generated presentation content. No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations are on file for the company.
